unit: code: 0 fine, 1 among about the widest 25% of ranges (a ranking, widest share range at or above 0.28; a fixed 0.4 limit would flag 94% of cells), 2 features outside the range seen at survey clusters, 3 both
method: Split conformal prediction on spatial (leave-districts-out) out-of-fold errors of the share model, 4 bins by predicted value, target coverage 80%. Range = prediction +/- bin half-width, clipped to 0..1. Grid, solar and unserved are bounded separately, so the three ranges do not sum to 1.
coverage_check: Nested spatial coverage: grid 82%, solar 82%, unserved 82%
limitations: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA: made up by src/make_demo_data.py to show that the pipeline runs. It is not Rwanda, not DHS data, and the numbers mean nothing for any real place. The range is calibrated on cluster-level errors, which include household sampling noise (about 25 households per cluster) and GPS displacement, so it is wider than the uncertainty of the true cell share. Coverage holds on average across districts, not for every cell.
title: Do-not-trust mask, 1 km
